THE STRATEGIC QUESTION: Why will fleet operators choose ChainSync?
WE SOLVE 4 PROBLEMS THAT COMPETITORS IGNORE
Locus charges Rs.1,500-3,000/vehicle. 10-vehicle fleet = Rs.15,000-30,000/month. Unaffordable for SMEs.
Rs.599/vehicle = Rs.5,990/month. 75% cheaper. ROI in first month.
Their enterprise sales model needs high prices. Rs.50,000+ CAC requires Rs.1,500+ pricing.
Enterprise tools need IT teams, API setup, 3-month implementation. SMEs have no IT staff.
Download app > Add vehicles > Start in 30 mins. Zero IT needed. WhatsApp support.
Products built for enterprises. Simplifying means rebuilding from scratch.
All competitors are English-only. 80% of fleet owners prefer Hindi or regional languages.
Full Hindi interface. Driver app with voice. Kannada, Tamil, Telugu in Y2.
Global products cannot localize deeply. Translation is not localization.
Annual contracts, credit cards, complex invoicing. SMEs want monthly, UPI, simple bills.
Monthly billing. UPI/PhonePe/GPay. WhatsApp invoice. No lock-in.
Enterprise billing systems cant handle micro-transactions economically.
